source.commit_note: last commit touching dataset/merged_v2/parameters_weights.mem; unchanged at inspected HEAD 18cd1c2b08bcccbbbbf4d5c2a286f90d35dcfad8

weights.encoding: one signed two's-complement Q8.8 word per line, 4 hex digits, value = code / 256
weights.orientation: neuron-major: line n*16 + j is the weight of input j for hidden neuron n (row-major [n_neurons x n_inputs], identical to the lif_step_weighted layout; no transpose)
weights.orientation_evidence: decoded words match round(snn_model.json neurons[n].weights[j] * 256) / 256 for 256/256 entries neuron-major and 140/256 if read input-major

stimulus.generator: myelin_accelerator::oracle::CaseRng::new(seed); per tick, per input j in 0..16 in order: x[j] = 1.0 if next_rate_f32() < rates[j] else 0.0
stimulus.note: Deterministic 0/1 spike inputs per the lif_step_weighted input contract. Axons 5-15 are held at zero because the shipped bank has zero weights there (unused width). This is a myelin test stimulus, not Spikenaut's analog-current / telemetry encoder.
